description: Sewer catch basins is a dataset listed in City of Vancouver Open Data Portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by City of Vancouver. Sewer catch basins is one dataset among several that describe the sewer network. Others are: Sanitary network (mains and manholes) Storm network (mains and manholes) Combined network (mains and manholes) City force mains (mans and manholes) GVRD (Metro Vancouver) trunk sewers (mains and manholes) Sewer catch basins The types of mains and manholes are distinguished ... Coverage: Vancouver. The portal files it under Water and sewer. Its keywords are sewer. The portal shows 44,975 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence - Vancouver (https://opendata.vancouver.ca/pages/licence/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-vancouver-ca-portal.
